name: orchestrator
description: Mission-control orchestration for Claude Code — one coordinator session brainstorms each ask, then runs each mission as a staged pipeline in guarded git worktrees: Fable-5 plans, pauses for your go, Codex gpt-5.6-sol executes and verifies, and the same Fable-5 session is resumed to code-review; the coordinator stays free for other work, mediates blocked questions, and does light acceptance + merge. All state lives on disk in a .orchestrator/ hub so any fresh session can resume.
